description_en: Generates a message channel access signature based on the AICCS instance ID and the agent account name
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID和坐席账号名称，生成消息通道访问签名
name: GenerateWebSocketSign

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification and can be generated by using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The AICCS instance ID. You can obtain the ID in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name, which is the mobile phone number or email address specified during account registration. The name is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of Success indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Data.description_en: The MessageBox message channel signature code

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API operation is called successfully. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
